mapper.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT IDENT1_0 AS CustomerCategoryCode, TEXTE_0 AS CustomerCategoryName FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'BPCCATEG' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'DESAXX'
AND ( ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = #{CustomerCategory} OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) = UPPER(#{CustomerCategory}) )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT DISTINCT IDENT2_0 AS CustomerTypeCode, TEXTE_0 AS CustomerTypeName FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES' AND ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = '30' -- customer type, airline, cargo, mro, constructor, broker
AND ( ATEXTRA.IDENT2_0 = #{CustomerType} OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) = UPPER(#{CustomerType}) )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT DISTINCT IDENT2_0 AS CustomerGeoRegionCode, TEXTE_0 AS CustomerGeoRegionName FROM EXPLOIT.ATEXTRA ATEXTRA WHERE ATEXTRA.CODFIC_0 = 'ATABDIV' AND ATEXTRA.ZONE_0 = 'LNGDES' AND ATEXTRA.IDENT1_0 = '31' -- geo region, Asia, Europe, America, Africa, Middle East, Other
AND ( ATEXTRA.IDENT2_0 = #{CustomerGeoRegion} OR UPPER(ATEXTRA.TEXTE_0) = UPPER(#{CustomerGeoRegion}) )
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = 'ENG'
AND ATEXTRA.LANGUE_0 = #{Language}

SELECT BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 AS CustomerCode, BPARTNER.BPRNAM_0 + IIF (BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1 = '', '', BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1) AS CustomerName FROM EXPLOIT.BPCUSTOMER BPCUSTOMER INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPARTNER BPARTNER ON BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 = BPCUSTOMER.BPCNUM_0 WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 = #{Customer} OR UPPER(BPARTNER.BPRNAM_0) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{Customer}) + '%' OR UPPER(BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{Customer}) + '%' )
mapper.select: ORDER BY CustomerCode ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

WITH T_BP_CUSTOMER_CATEGORY AS ( ), T_BP_CUSTOMER_TYPE AS ( ), T_BP_CUSTOMER_GEO_REGION AS ( ), T_BP_COUNTRY AS ( ) SELECT BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 AS CustomerCode, BPARTNER.BPRNAM_0 + IIF (BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1 = '', '', BPARTNER.BPRNAM_1) AS CustomerName, BPARTNER.BRRSHO_0 AS CustomerShortName, BPARTNER.ENAFLG_0 AS Enabled, T_BP_CUSTOMER_CATEGORY.CustomerCategoryCode AS CustomerCategoryCode, T_BP_CUSTOMER_CATEGORY.CustomerCategoryName AS CustomerCategoryName, T_BP_CUSTOMER_TYPE.CustomerTypeCode AS CustomerTypeCode, T_BP_CUSTOMER_TYPE.TypeName AS CustomerTypeName, T_BP_CUSTOMER_GEO_REGION.CustomerGeoRegionCode AS CustomerGeoRegionCode, T_BP_CUSTOMER_GEO_REGION.CustomerGeoRegionName AS CustomerGeoRegionName, T_BP_COUNTRY.CountryCode AS CountryCode, T_BP_COUNTRY.CountryName AS CountryName, BPADDRESS.POSCOD_0 AS PostalCode, BPADDRESS.SAT_0 AS UsStateCode, BPADDRESS.CTY_0 AS CityName, BPADDRESS.BPAADDLIG_0 AS Address0, BPADDRESS.BPAADDLIG_1 AS Address1, BPADDRESS.BPAADDLIG_2 AS Address2, BPADDRESS.TEL_0 AS Tel0, BPADDRESS.TEL_1 AS Tel1, BPADDRESS.TEL_2 AS Tel2, BPADDRESS.TEL_3 AS Tel3, BPADDRESS.TEL_4 AS Tel4, BPADDRESS.FAX_0 AS Fax0, BPADDRESS.MOB_0 AS Mobile0, BPADDRESS.WEB_0 AS Web0, BPADDRESS.WEB_1 AS Web1, BPADDRESS.WEB_2 AS Web2, BPADDRESS.WEB_3 AS Web3, BPADDRESS.WEB_4 AS Web4 FROM EXPLOIT.BPCUSTOMER BPCUSTOMER INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPARTNER BPARTNER ON BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 = BPCUSTOMER.BPCNUM_0 LEFT JOIN T_BP_CUSTOMER_CATEGORY ON BPCUSTOMER.BCGCOD_0 = T_BP_CUSTOMER_CATEGORY.CustomerCategoryCode LEFT JOIN T_BP_CUSTOMER_TYPE ON BPCUSTOMER.TSCCOD_0 = T_BP_CUSTOMER_TYPE.CustomerTypeCode LEFT JOIN T_BP_CUSTOMER_GEO_REGION ON BPCUSTOMER.TSCCOD_1 = T_BP_CUSTOMER_GEO_REGION.CustomerGeoRegionCode LEFT JOIN T_BP_COUNTRY ON BPARTNER.CRY_0 = T_BP_COUNTRY.CountryCode LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.BPADDRESS BPADDRESS ON BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 = BPADDRESS.BPANUM_0 AND BPADDRESS.BPAADDFLG_0 = 2 WHERE 1 = 1
AND BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 = #{Customer}
